Documentation excerpts:

<excerpt id="customers-api:searchCustomers:operation">
[customers-api] GET /v1/customers · operation
operationId: searchCustomers
Summary: Search customers
Description: Finds customers by email address or last name. Results are returned one page at a time.
Tags: Customers
Security: bearerAuth (OAuth2 bearer token in the Authorization header; scopes: customers:read) AND apiKey (API key in header X-Api-Key)
Parameters: X-Correlation-Id (header), email (query), lastName (query), page (query), pageSize (query)
Responses: 200, 400, 401, 403, 429
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="customers-api:CustomerPage:component_schema">
[customers-api] component schema CustomerPage
Schema CustomerPage: object
Description: One page of customers.
Required fields: items, page, pageSize, totalItems
- items (array of Customer, required): The customers on this page.
- page (integer, required): Page number, starting at 1.
- pageSize (integer, required): Number of customers requested per page.
- totalItems (integer, required): Total number of customers that match the search.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="customers-api:searchCustomers:parameters">
[customers-api] GET /v1/customers · parameters
- X-Correlation-Id (header, optional, string, max length 64): Optional identifier chosen by the caller to trace a call across systems. It is echoed in the X-Correlation-Id response header and in the Problem correlationId field.
- email (query, optional, string, format email): Exact email address to look for.
- lastName (query, optional, string): Last name to look for.
- page (query, optional, integer, default 1, min 1): Page number, starting at 1.
- pageSize (query, optional, integer, default 20, min 1, max 100): Number of customers on a page.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="customers-api:searchCustomers:response:200">
[customers-api] GET /v1/customers · response 200
Response 200: A page of matching customers.
Headers:
- X-Correlation-Id (string): The correlation identifier of the call. It repeats the caller's value, or a generated one when none was sent.
Content application/json: CustomerPage
- items (array of Customer, required): The customers on this page.
- page (integer, required): Page number, starting at 1.
- pageSize (integer, required): Number of customers requested per page.
- totalItems (integer, required): Total number of customers that match the search.
</excerpt>

<excerpt id="accounts-api:listTransactions:parameters">
[accounts-api] GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/transactions · parameters
- accountId (path, required, string): Identifier of the account.
- X-Correlation-Id (header, optional, string, max length 64): Optional identifier chosen by the caller to trace a call across systems. It is echoed in the X-Correlation-Id response header and in the Problem correlationId field.
- fromDate (query, optional, string, format date): Earliest booking date to include.
- toDate (query, optional, string, format date): Latest booking date to include.
- cursor (query, optional, string): Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by the previous page.
- limit (query, optional, integer, default 100, min 1, max 500): Maximum number of transactions on a page.
</excerpt>
